outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge); it is not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.

Aside from the micrographs, panel B includes two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing group means with error bars (n=20). No individual data points are overlaid on these bars, so the underlying data spread cannot be assessed.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a quantitative plot.
Panel D includes bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity with error bars and sample sizes (n) noted inside the bars, but individual data points for each animal/sample are not shown.
Panel E shows FACS histograms (cell count vs. TMRM intensity), which are full population distributions rather than bar charts of means, so overlaying individual points is not applicable/needed.
